name: opensearch
description: Use the Amazon OpenSearch Service configuration API to create, configure, and manage OpenSearch Service domains.

subcommands.name: accept-inbound-connection
subcommands.description: Allows the destination Amazon OpenSearch Service domain owner to accept an inbound cross-cluster search connection request.

subcommands.name: add-data-source
subcommands.description: Creates a new direct-query data source to the specified domain.

subcommands.name: add-direct-query-data-source
subcommands.description: Adds a new data source in Amazon OpenSearch Service so that you can perform direct queries on external data.

subcommands.name: add-tags
subcommands.description: Attaches tags to an existing Amazon OpenSearch Service domain, data source, or application.

subcommands.name: associate-package
subcommands.description: Associates a package with an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: associate-packages
subcommands.description: Operation in the Amazon OpenSearch Service API for associating multiple packages with a domain simultaneously.

subcommands.name: attach-data-source
subcommands.description: Attaches a data source to an OpenSearch application.

subcommands.name: authorize-vpc-endpoint-access
subcommands.description: Provides access to an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain through the use of an interface VPC endpoint.

subcommands.name: cancel-domain-config-change
subcommands.description: Cancels a pending configuration change on an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: cancel-service-software-update
subcommands.description: Cancels a scheduled service software update for an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: create-application
subcommands.description: Creates an OpenSearch UI application.

subcommands.name: create-domain
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: create-index
subcommands.description: Creates an OpenSearch index with optional automatic semantic enrichment for specified text fields.

subcommands.name: create-outbound-connection
subcommands.description: Creates a new cross-cluster search connection from a source Amazon OpenSearch Service domain to a destination domain.

subcommands.name: create-package
subcommands.description: Creates a package for use with Amazon OpenSearch Service domains.

subcommands.name: create-vpc-endpoint
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed VPC endpoint.

subcommands.name: delete-application
subcommands.description: Deletes a specified OpenSearch application.

subcommands.name: delete-data-source
subcommands.description: Deletes a direct-query data source.

subcommands.name: delete-direct-query-data-source
subcommands.description: Deletes a previously configured direct query data source from Amazon OpenSearch Service.

subcommands.name: delete-domain
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain and all of its data.

subcommands.name: delete-inbound-connection
subcommands.description: Allows the destination Amazon OpenSearch Service domain owner to delete an existing inbound cross-cluster search connection.

subcommands.name: delete-index
subcommands.description: Deletes an OpenSearch index.

subcommands.name: delete-outbound-connection
subcommands.description: Allows the source Amazon OpenSearch Service domain owner to delete an existing outbound cross-cluster search connection.

subcommands.name: delete-package
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon OpenSearch Service package.

subcommands.name: delete-vpc-endpoint
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed interface VPC endpoint.

subcommands.name: deregister-capability
subcommands.description: Deregisters a capability from an OpenSearch UI application.

subcommands.name: describe-data-source-attachment
subcommands.description: Returns the current status and details of a specific data source attachment for an OpenSearch application.

subcommands.name: describe-domain
subcommands.description: Describes the domain configuration for the specified Amazon OpenSearch Service domain, including the domain ID, domain service endpoint, and domain ARN.

subcommands.name: describe-domain-auto-tunes
subcommands.description: Returns the list of optimizations that Auto-Tune has made to an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: describe-domain-change-progress
subcommands.description: Returns information about the current blue/green deployment happening on an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: describe-domain-config
subcommands.description: Returns the configuration of an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: describe-domain-health
subcommands.description: Returns information about domain and node health, the standby Availability Zone, number of nodes per Availability Zone, and shard count per node.

subcommands.name: describe-domain-nodes
subcommands.description: Returns information about domain and nodes, including data nodes, master nodes, ultrawarm nodes, Availability Zone(s), standby nodes, node configurations, and node states.

subcommands.name: describe-domains
subcommands.description: Returns domain configuration information about the specified Amazon OpenSearch Service domains.

subcommands.name: describe-dry-run-progress
subcommands.description: Describes the progress of a pre-update dry run analysis on an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: describe-inbound-connections
subcommands.description: Lists all the inbound cross-cluster search connections for a destination (remote) Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: describe-insight-details
subcommands.description: Describes the details of an existing insight for an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: describe-instance-type-limits
subcommands.description: Describes the instance count, storage, and master node limits for a given OpenSearch or Elasticsearch version and instance type.

subcommands.name: describe-outbound-connections
subcommands.description: Lists all the outbound cross-cluster connections for a local (source) Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: describe-packages
subcommands.description: Describes all packages available to OpenSearch Service.

subcommands.name: describe-reserved-instance-offerings
subcommands.description: Describes the available Amazon OpenSearch Service Reserved Instance offerings for a given Region.

subcommands.name: describe-reserved-instances
subcommands.description: Describes the Amazon OpenSearch Service instances that you have reserved in a given Region.

subcommands.name: describe-vpc-endpoints
subcommands.description: Describes one or more Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed VPC endpoints.

subcommands.name: detach-data-source
subcommands.description: Removes a data source from an OpenSearch application.

subcommands.name: dissociate-package
subcommands.description: Removes a package from the specified Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: dissociate-packages
subcommands.description: Dissociates multiple packages from a domain simultaneously.

subcommands.name: get-application
subcommands.description: Retrieves the configuration and status of an existing OpenSearch application.

subcommands.name: get-capability
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a registered capability for an OpenSearch UI application, including its configuration and current status.

subcommands.name: get-compatible-versions
subcommands.description: Returns a map of OpenSearch or Elasticsearch versions and the versions you can upgrade them to.

subcommands.name: get-data-source
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a direct query data source.

subcommands.name: get-default-application-setting
subcommands.description: Gets the ARN of the current default application.

subcommands.name: get-direct-query-data-source
subcommands.description: Returns detailed configuration information for a specific direct query data source in Amazon OpenSearch Service.

subcommands.name: get-domain-maintenance-status
subcommands.description: The status of the maintenance action.

subcommands.name: get-index
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about an OpenSearch index including its schema and semantic enrichment configuration.

subcommands.name: get-migration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the current status and progress of a migration job, including the number of exported and imported objects and error details if the migration failed.

subcommands.name: get-package-version-history
subcommands.description: Returns a list of Amazon OpenSearch Service package versions, along with their creation time, commit message, and plugin properties (if the package is a zip plugin package).

subcommands.name: get-upgrade-history
subcommands.description: Retrieves the complete history of the last 10 upgrades performed on an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: get-upgrade-status
subcommands.description: Returns the most recent status of the last upgrade or upgrade eligibility check performed on an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: insight-feedback
subcommands.description: Submits feedback for an existing insight in an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: list-applications
subcommands.description: Lists all OpenSearch applications under your account.

subcommands.name: list-data-source-attachments
subcommands.description: Returns a paginated list of all data source attachments for an OpenSearch application, including attachments in all states (PENDING, ATTACHED, and FAILED).

subcommands.name: list-data-sources
subcommands.description: Lists direct-query data sources for a specific domain.

subcommands.name: list-direct-query-data-sources
subcommands.description: Lists an inventory of all the direct query data sources that you have configured within Amazon OpenSearch Service.

subcommands.name: list-domain-maintenances
subcommands.description: A list of maintenance actions for the domain.

subcommands.name: list-domain-names
subcommands.description: Returns the names of all Amazon OpenSearch Service domains owned by the current user in the active Region.

subcommands.name: list-domains-for-package
subcommands.description: Lists all Amazon OpenSearch Service domains associated with a given package.

subcommands.name: list-insights
subcommands.description: Lists insights for an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain or Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-instance-type-details
subcommands.description: Lists all instance types and available features for a given OpenSearch or Elasticsearch version.

subcommands.name: list-migrations
subcommands.description: Lists migration jobs for an Amazon OpenSearch Service application.

subcommands.name: list-packages-for-domain
subcommands.description: Lists all packages associated with an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: list-scheduled-actions
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of configuration changes that are scheduled for a domain.

subcommands.name: list-tags
subcommands.description: Returns all resource tags for an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain, data source, or application.

subcommands.name: list-versions
subcommands.description: Lists all versions of OpenSearch and Elasticsearch that Amazon OpenSearch Service supports.

subcommands.name: list-vpc-endpoint-access
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about each Amazon Web Services principal that is allowed to access a given Amazon OpenSearch Service domain through the use of an interface VPC endpoint.

subcommands.name: list-vpc-endpoints
subcommands.description: Retrieves all Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed VPC endpoints in the current Amazon Web Services account and Region.

subcommands.name: list-vpc-endpoints-for-domain
subcommands.description: Retrieves all Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed VPC endpoints associated with a particular domain.

subcommands.name: purchase-reserved-instance-offering
subcommands.description: Allows you to purchase Amazon OpenSearch Service Reserved Instances.

subcommands.name: put-default-application-setting
subcommands.description: Sets the default application to the application with the specified ARN.

subcommands.name: register-capability
subcommands.description: Registers a capability for an OpenSearch UI application.

subcommands.name: reject-inbound-connection
subcommands.description: Allows the remote Amazon OpenSearch Service domain owner to reject an inbound cross-cluster connection request.

subcommands.name: remove-tags
subcommands.description: Removes the specified set of tags from an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain, data source, or application.

subcommands.name: revoke-vpc-endpoint-access
subcommands.description: Revokes access to an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain that was provided through an interface VPC endpoint.

subcommands.name: rollback-service-software-update
subcommands.description: Rolls back a service software update for a domain to the previous version.

subcommands.name: start-domain-maintenance
subcommands.description: Starts the node maintenance process on the data node.

subcommands.name: start-migration
subcommands.description: Initiates a migration job to migrate saved objects from a data source to an Amazon OpenSearch Service application workspace.

subcommands.name: start-service-software-update
subcommands.description: Schedules a service software update for an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: update-application
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration and settings of an existing OpenSearch application.

subcommands.name: update-data-source
subcommands.description: Updates a direct-query data source.

subcommands.name: update-direct-query-data-source
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration or properties of an existing direct query data source in Amazon OpenSearch Service.

subcommands.name: update-domain-config
subcommands.description: Modifies the cluster configuration of the specified Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: update-index
subcommands.description: Updates an existing OpenSearch index schema and semantic enrichment configuration.

subcommands.name: update-package
subcommands.description: Updates a package for use with Amazon OpenSearch Service domains.

subcommands.name: update-package-scope
subcommands.description: Updates the scope of a package.

subcommands.name: update-scheduled-action
subcommands.description: Reschedules a planned domain configuration change for a later time.

subcommands.name: update-vpc-endpoint
subcommands.description: Modifies an Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed interface VPC endpoint.

subcommands.name: upgrade-domain
subcommands.description: Allows you to either upgrade your Amazon OpenSearch Service domain or perform an upgrade eligibility check to a compatible version of OpenSearch or Elasticsearch.
